bulk RNA-seq per-sample expression matrix

normalized/log-transformed expression

Basal vs Luminal call per sample

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

if (!requireNamespace("DESeq2", quietly = TRUE)) {

if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("biomaRt")
}

if (!requireNamespace("pamr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pamr")

library(DESeq2)
library(pamr)
library(tidyverse)

```
Convert tpm to log2(tpm+1)
```{r}

# Load data
tpm_raw <- read.delim("~/Documents/GitHub/EV-Resistance-analysis/data/counts_tpm_gene_id.tsv", row.names = 1)
tpm_raw$gene_id <- sub("\\..*", "", rownames(tpm_raw))
rownames(tpm_raw) <- NULL

# Sample columns are all columns except gene_id
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(tpm_raw), "gene_id")

# Deduplicate: keep highest mean-expressed row per Ensembl ID
tpm_raw$mean_expr <- rowMeans(tpm_raw[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

tpm_dedup <- tpm_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  slice_max(mean_expr, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Put gene IDs back as row names
rownames(tpm_dedup) <- tpm_dedup$gene_id

# Keep only expression/sample columns
tpm_dedup <- tpm_dedup[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Log2 transform
tpm_log2 <- log2(tpm_dedup + 1)

rm(tpm_dedup)

```

Ensembl gene IDs -->gene symbols
```{r}
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)

ensg_ids <- rownames(tpm_log2)
mart <- useEnsembl(
  biomart = "genes",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"
)


gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol", "external_gene_name"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = ensg_ids,
  mart = mart
)

tpm_named <- tpm_log2 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
  left_join(gene_map, by = "ensembl_gene_id")

tpm_named <- tpm_named %>% mutate(gene_name = coalesce(na_if(as.character(hgnc_symbol), ""), as.character(ensembl_gene_id)), mean_expr = rowMeans(across(all_of(colnames(tpm_log2))), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% group_by(gene_name) %>% slice_max(mean_expr, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

tpm_mapped <- tpm_named %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, dplyr::all_of(colnames(tpm_log2))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(tpm_mapped) <- tpm_mapped$gene_name

tpm_mapped <- tpm_mapped[, colnames(tpm_log2), drop = FALSE]

```
Subset to BASE47 genes
```{r}
base47_genes <- c(
  "AHNAK2","ANXA10","ATP1B3","BIRC5","BMP4","BTG4","C1orf116",
  "CA9","CAV1","CDCA3","CDH3","CLIC3","CTSL","DSC3","DSG3",
  "EGFR","ELF3","ERBB2","ERRFI1","FOXA1","GATA3","GPX2","HER2",
  "IRF6","KRT14","KRT17","KRT5","KRT6A","KRT6B","LAMC2","MMP10",
  "MMP14","PPARG","PTPN13","RAB25","RPS6KA4","S100A7","S100A8",
  "S100A9","SOX10","STAT3","TACSTD2","TRIM29","TYMP","UPK1A",
  "UPK1B","UPK2"
)


tpm_base47 <- tpm_named[tpm_named$external_gene_name %in% base47_genes, ]

rownames(tpm_base47) <- tpm_base47$hgnc_symbol
tpm_base47 <- subset(tpm_base47, select=-c(external_gene_name, hgnc_symbol))
```

Download BASE47 classifier
```{r}
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kimlabunc/Kardos_Rose_NanoString/main/BASE47_RNASEQ_PREDICTOR_DO_NOT_EDIT.txt",
  destfile = "BASE47_RNASEQ_PREDICTOR_DO_NOT_EDIT.txt"
)

raw <- readLines("BASE47_RNASEQ_PREDICTOR_DO_NOT_EDIT.txt")

# Parse: row 1 = sample names, row 2 = class labels, rows 3+ = gene centroids
sample_names <- strsplit(raw[1], "\t")[[1]]
sample_names <- sample_names[-1]  # drop leading empty string

class_labels <- as.integer(strsplit(sub("^\t", "", raw[2]), "\t")[[1]])

gene_lines <- raw[3:length(raw)]
gene_mat <- do.call(rbind, lapply(gene_lines, function(x) {
  vals <- strsplit(x, "\t")[[1]]
  as.numeric(vals[-1])
}))
gene_names <- sapply(strsplit(gene_lines, "\t"), `[`, 1)
rownames(gene_mat) <- gene_names
colnames(gene_mat) <- sample_names

# Compute centroids (1 = Luminal, 2 = Basal)
centroid_luminal <- rowMeans(gene_mat[, class_labels == 1])
centroid_basal   <- rowMeans(gene_mat[, class_labels == 2])
centroids <- cbind(Luminal = centroid_luminal, Basal = centroid_basal)

cat("Predictor genes:", nrow(centroids), "\n")
```

Subset to shared genes
```{r}
shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(tpm_mapped), rownames(centroids))
cat("Shared genes:", length(shared_genes), "of", nrow(centroids), "\n")
cat("Missing:", setdiff(rownames(centroids), rownames(tpm_mapped)), "\n")

query_mat    <- as.matrix(tpm_mapped[shared_genes, ])
centroid_sub <- centroids[shared_genes, ]
```
```{r}
calls <- apply(query_mat, 2, function(sample_expr) {
  r_lum <- cor(sample_expr, centroid_sub[, "Luminal"], method = "pearson")
  r_bas <- cor(sample_expr, centroid_sub[, "Basal"],   method = "pearson")
  data.frame(
    cor_luminal = round(r_lum, 4),
    cor_basal   = round(r_bas, 4),
    subtype     = ifelse(r_bas > r_lum, "Basal", "Luminal")
  )
})

results <- do.call(rbind, calls)
results$sample <- colnames(query_mat)
results <- results[, c("sample", "subtype", "cor_luminal", "cor_basal")]

print(results)


```
